zh: 每位玩家橫置其墨水池中所有卡。然後，每位墨水池中超過 3 張卡的玩家隨機從其墨水池將卡移回手牌，直到其墨水池剩 3 張卡。

name: Emerald Coil
en:
SHIMMERING WINGS During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character
gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 閃爍之翼　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Grandmother Fa - Spirited Elder
en:
I'VE GOT ALL THE LUCK WE'LL NEED Whenever this
character quests, you may give chosen character
of yours +2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 我有我們需要的所有運氣　每當這個角色探險時，你可以給予你一個指定角色本回合 +2 ¤。

name: Queen of Hearts - Losing Her Temper
en:
ROYAL PAIN While this character has damage,
she gets +3 ¤.
zh: 皇家之痛　當這個角色有傷害時，她獲得 +3 ¤。

name: The Matchmaker - Unforgiving Expert
en:
YOU ARE A DISGRACE! Whenever this character
challenges another character, each opponent
loses 1 lore.
zh: 你真是個恥辱！　每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Denahi - Impatient Hunter
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 2.)
zh:
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）
抵抗 +2（這個角色受到的傷害減少 2。）

name: Stabbington Brother - Without a Patch
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
GET 'EM! Your other characters named
Stabbington Brother gain Rush.
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
抓住他們！　你其他名為 Stabbington Brother 的角色獲得突襲。

name: Belle - Mechanic Extraordinaire
en:
Shift 7
SALVAGE For each item card in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡
less to play this character using her Shift ability.
REPURPOSE Whenever this character quests, you may put
up to 3 item cards from your discard on the bottom of your
deck to gain 1 lore for each item card moved this way.
zh:
變身 7
打撈　你棄牌堆每有一張物品卡，你以變身能力打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。
再利用　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將棄牌堆中至多 3 張物品卡放到你牌庫底，以此方式每移動一張物品卡就獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Cy-Bug - Invasive Enemy
en:
HIVE MIND This character gets +1 ¤ for each
other character you have in play.
zh: 蜂巢意識　你在場每有一個其他角色，這個角色就獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Stabbington Brother - With a Patch

CRIME OF OPPORTUNITY When you play this
character, chosen opponent loses 1 lore.
zh: 趁機犯罪　當你打出這個角色時，指定對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Card Soldiers - Royal Troops
en:
TAKE POINT While a damaged character is in
play, this character gets +2 ¤.
zh: 打頭陣　當場上有帶傷害的角色時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Cogsworth - Climbing Clock
en:
STILL USEFUL While you have an item card in your
discard, this character gets +2 ¤.
zh: 還有用　當你的棄牌堆中有一張物品卡時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Beagle Boys - Small-Time Crooks
en:
HURRY IT UP! Whenever this character quests,
chosen character of yours gains Rush and
Resist +1 this turn. (They can challenge the turn
they're played. Damage dealt to them is reduced
by 1.)
zh: 快點！　每當這個角色探險時，你一個指定角色本回合獲得突襲和抵抗 +1。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Li Shang - Newly Promoted
en:
I WON'T LET YOU DOWN This character can
challenge ready characters.

has damage, he gets +2 ¤.

我不會讓你失望　這個角色可以挑戰已準備的角色。

name: Moana - Island Explorer

冒險精神　每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，你另一個指定角色本回合獲得 +3 ¤。

Deal 5 damage to chosen character.
zh: 我受夠了！　⟳，2 ⬡，消滅你 2 個物品 — 對指定角色造成 5 點傷害。

INTIMIDATING AND AWE-INSPIRING Whenever one of your
characters challenges, they gain Resist +2 during that
challenge. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
GUARDIAN OF LOST SOULS During your turn, whenever
one of your characters banishes another character in a

zh:
威嚇又懾人　每當你一個角色挑戰時，他們在該次挑戰中獲得抵抗 +2。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

chosen character with 2 ¤ or less.
zh: 這到底怎麼發生的？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅你一個指定物品來抽一張牌。若被消滅的物品名為 Maurice's Machine，你還可以消滅一個 2 ¤ 或以下的指定角色。

name: Ratigan - Nefarious Criminal

zh: 精彩的演出　每當你在這個角色橫置時打出一個行動，獲得 1 點傳說值。

zh: 拆解　當這個物品被消滅時，你可以將一張費用 2 或以下的物品卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

好好利用　你可以橫置你 4 個物品，來免費打出這個角色。

name: Mattias - Arendelle General

I'VE COME TO COLLECT Whenever this character

name: Dawson - Puzzling Sleuth

BE SENSIBLE Once during your turn, whenever a

of your deck. You may put it on either the top or
the bottom of your deck.
zh: 理智點　你回合中一次，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，查看你牌庫頂的卡。你可以將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Tamatoa - Happy as a Clam

COOLEST COLLECTION When you play this

最酷的收藏　當你打出這個角色時，將至多 2 張物品卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。

變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Heihei 的角色上。）

Ward (Opponents can't choose this character

守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Marie - Favored Kitten

I'LL SHOW YOU Whenever this character quests,

zh: 我秀給你看　每當這個角色探險時，你可以給予指定角色本回合 -2 ¤。

name: Pepper - Quick-Thinking Puppy

IN THE NICK OF TIME Whenever one of your Puppy

name: Robin Hood - Eye for Detail

Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)

name: Penny the Orphan - Clever Child

OUR BOTTLE WORKED! While you have a Hero

守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is

name: Baymax - Upgraded Robot

Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add

characters challenges another character, if it's
the second challenge this turn, gain 3 lore.
zh: 訓練演習　每當你一個角色挑戰另一個角色時，若這是本回合第二次挑戰，獲得 3 點傳說值。

name: Razoul - Menacing Guard
en:
MY ORDERS COME FROM JAFAR When you play this
character, if you have a character named Jafar in
play, you may banish chosen item.
zh: 我的命令來自 Jafar　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個名為 Jafar 的角色在場，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Jafar - Aspiring Ruler
en:
THAT'S BETTER When you play this character,
chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 這樣好多了　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Tick-Tock - Relentless Crocodile
en:
LOOKING FOR LUNCH During your turn, this
character gains Evasive while a Pirate character is in
play. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
zh: 找午餐　在你的回合中，當場上有海盜角色時，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Kakamora - Band of Pirates
en:
SHOWBOATING While you have another Pirate
character in play, this character gains Challenger +3.
(While challenging, this character gets +3 ¤.)
zh: 炫耀　當你另有一個海盜角色在場時，這個角色獲得挑戰者 +3。（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +3 ¤。）

name: Mulan - Disguised Soldier
en:
WHERE DO I SIGN IN? When you play this
character, you may draw a card, then choose and
discard a card.
zh: 我在哪裡報到？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Orville - Albatross Air
en:
WELCOME ABOARD, FOLKS During your turn, while you
have a character named Miss Bianca or Bernard in
play, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
zh: 歡迎登機，各位　在你的回合中，當你有一個名為 Miss Bianca 或 Bernard 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Miss Bianca - Unwavering Agent
en:
HAVE A LITTLE FAITH If you have an Ally character
in play, you pay 2 ⬡ less to play this character.
zh: 有點信心　若你有一個盟友角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Aladdin - Research Assistant
en:
HELPING HAND Whenever this character quests,
you may play an Ally character with cost 3 or less
for free.
PUT IN THE EFFORT While this character is
exerted, your Ally characters get +1 ¤.
zh:
援手　每當這個角色探險時，你可以免費打出一個費用 3 或以下的盟友角色。
付出努力　當這個角色橫置時，你的盟友角色獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Bagheera - Guardian Jaguar
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
YOU'VE GOT TO BE BRAVE During an opponent's turn,
when this character is banished, deal 2 damage to
each opposing character.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
你必須勇敢　在對手的回合中，當這個角色被消滅時，對每個對方角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Gantu - Experienced Enforcer
en:
CLOSE ALL CHANNELS When you play this
character, characters can't exert to sing songs
until the start of your next turn.
DON'T GET ANY IDEAS Each player pays 2 ⬡ more
to play actions or items. (This doesn't apply to
singing songs.)
zh:
關閉所有頻道　當你打出這個角色時，角色在你的下個回合開始前不能橫置來詠唱歌曲。
別打歪主意　每位玩家打出行動或物品時多支付 2 ⬡。（此效果不適用於詠唱歌曲。）

name: Mickey Mouse - Inspirational Warrior
en:
STIRRING SPIRIT During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge,
you may play a character for free.
zh: 激昂鬥志　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以免費打出一個角色。

name: Restoring Atlantis
en:
Your characters can't be challenged until the start of
your next turn.
zh: 你的角色在你的下個回合開始前不能被挑戰。

name: Double Trouble
en: Deal 1 damage each to up to 2 chosen characters.
zh: 對至多 2 個指定角色各造成 1 點傷害。

name: Steel Coil
en:
METALLIC FLOW During your turn, whenever a card
is put into your inkwell, you may draw a card, then
choose and discard a card.
zh: 金屬之流　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Training Staff
en:
PRECISION STRIKE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character
gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while
challenging.)
zh: 精準打擊　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Aurora - Waking Beauty
en:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing
songs.)
SWEET DREAMS Whenever you remove 1 or more
damage from a character, ready this character.
She can't quest or challenge for the rest of this
turn.
zh:
歌手 5（這個角色視為費用 5 來詠唱歌曲。）
甜美的夢　每當你從一個角色身上移除 1 點或以上的傷害時，準備這個角色。她本回合剩餘時間內不能探險或挑戰。

name: Mirabel Madrigal - Musically Talented
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Mirabel Madrigal.)
HER OWN SPECIAL GIFT Whenever this character
quests, you may return a song card with cost 3
or less from your discard to your hand.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mirabel Madrigal 的角色上。）
她獨特的天賦　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將一張費用 3 或以下的歌曲卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Bolt - Superdog
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Bolt.)
MARK OF POWER Whenever you ready this character,
gain 1 lore for each other undamaged character you
have in play.
BOLT STARE ⟳ — Banish chosen Illusion character.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Bolt 的角色上。）
力量印記　每當你準備這個角色時，你另有一個無傷害的角色就獲得 1 點傳說值。
Bolt 凝視　⟳ — 消滅指定的幻象角色。

name: The Glass Slipper
en:
PERFECT PAIR You may only have 2 copies of The
Glass Slipper in your deck.
SEARCH THE KINGDOM Banish this item, ⟳ one of
your Prince characters — Search your deck for a
Princess character card and reveal it to all players.
Put that card into your hand and shuffle your deck.
zh:
完美的一對　你的牌庫中只能有 2 張 The Glass Slipper。
搜尋王國　消滅這個物品，橫置你一個王子角色 — 在你的牌庫中搜尋一張公主角色卡並向所有玩家展示。將該卡加入你的手牌並洗你的牌庫。

name: Donald Duck - Flustered Sorcerer
en:
OBFUSCATE! Opponents need 25 lore to win
the game.
zh: 混淆！　對手需要 25 點傳說值才能贏得遊戲。

name: Jafar - Newly Crowned
en:
THIS IS NOT DONE YET During an opponent's
turn, whenever one of your Illusion characters
is banished, you may return that card to your
hand.
zh: 這還沒完　在對手的回合中，每當你一個幻象角色被消滅時，你可以將該卡移回你的手牌。

name: Show Me More!
en: Each player draws 3 cards.
zh: 每位玩家抽 3 張牌。

name: Tramp - Enterprising Dog
en:
HEY, PIDGE If you have a character named Lady in
play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
NO TIME FOR WISECRACKS When you play this
character, chosen character of yours gets +1 ¤ this
turn for each other character you have in play.
zh:
嘿，鴿子　若你有一個名為 Lady 的角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
沒時間耍嘴皮子　當你打出這個角色時，你在場每有一個其他角色，你一個指定角色本回合就獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Mad Hatter - Unruly Eccentric
en:
UNBIRTHDAY PRESENT Whenever a damaged
character challenges another character, you
may draw a card.
zh: 非生日禮物　每當有帶傷害的角色挑戰另一個角色時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Hiro Hamada - Armor Designer
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Hiro Hamada.)
YOU CAN BE WAY MORE Your Floodborn characters
that have a card under them gain Evasive and Ward.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.
Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Hiro Hamada 的角色上。）
你能變得更強　你下方有卡的 Floodborn 角色獲得迴避和守護。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: The Return of Hercules
en:
Each player may reveal a character card from their
hand and play it for free.
zh: 每位玩家可以展示一張手牌中的角色卡並免費打出它。

name: Ratigan - Nefarious Criminal
en:
A MARVELOUS PERFORMANCE Whenever you
play an action while this character is exerted,
gain 1 lore.
zh: 精彩的演出　每當你在這個角色橫置時打出一個行動，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Belle - Mechanic Extraordinaire
en:
Shift 7
SALVAGE For each item card in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡
less to play this character using her Shift ability.
REPURPOSE Whenever this character quests, you may
put up to 3 item cards from your discard on the bottom of
your deck to gain 1 lore for each item card moved this way.
zh:
變身 7
打撈　你棄牌堆每有一張物品卡，你以變身能力打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。
再利用　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將棄牌堆中至多 3 張物品卡放到你牌庫底，以此方式每移動一張物品卡就獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Devil's Eye Diamond
en:
THE PRICE OF POWER ⟳ — If one of your
characters took damage this turn, gain 1 lore.
zh: 力量的代價　⟳ — 若你一個角色本回合受到過傷害，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Tamatoa - Happy as a Clam
en:
COOLEST COLLECTION When you play this
character, return up to 2 item cards from your
discard to your hand.
I'M BEAUTIFUL, BABY! Whenever this character
quests, you may play an item for free.
zh:
最酷的收藏　當你打出這個角色時，將至多 2 張物品卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。
我很美，寶貝！　每當這個角色探險時，你可以免費打出一個物品。

name: All Is Found
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put up to 2 cards from your discard into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將你棄牌堆中至多 2 張卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Mickey Mouse - Inspirational Warrior
en:
STIRRING SPIRIT During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may play a character for free.
zh: 激昂鬥志　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以免費打出一個角色。

name: Restoring Atlantis
en:
Your characters can't be challenged until the start
of your next turn.
zh: 你的角色在你的下個回合開始前不能被挑戰。

name: Bolt - Superdog
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Bolt.)
MARK OF POWER Whenever you ready this character,
gain 1 lore for each other undamaged character you
have in play.
BOLT STARE ⟳ — Banish chosen Illusion character.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Bolt 的角色上。）
力量印記　每當你準備這個角色時，你另有一個無傷害的角色就獲得 1 點傳說值。
Bolt 凝視　⟳ — 消滅指定的幻象角色。

name: Elsa - Ice Maker
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Elsa.)
WINTER WALL Whenever this character quests,
you may exert chosen character. If you do and you
have a character named Anna in play, the chosen
character can't ready at the start of their next turn.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Elsa 的角色上。）
寒冬之牆　每當這個角色探險時，你可以橫置指定角色。若你這麼做且你有一個名為 Anna 的角色在場，該指定角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。
